answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted identity with slow-release reputation: each agent locks tokens that thaw like a glacier, so spinning up a hundred fake identities means freezing a hundred deposits. Honest work earns a velvet-smooth reputation score that compounds over time, while clones stay thin and cheap to spot. When a dispute opens, the delta between an agent claimed output and its verified attestations triggers slashing, so sybils lose more than they gain.
